cards.card_text: But resistance comes from what was called the Synagogue of the Freedmen, with Cyrenians, Alexandrians, and men from the provinces of Cilicia and Asia, and they dispute with Stephen.
cards.verse_text: But resistance arose from what was called the Synagogue of the Freedmen, including Cyrenians, Alexandrians, and men from the provinces of Cilicia and Asia.
cards.snippet: …arose from what was called the Synagogue of the Freedmen, including Cyrenians, Alexandrians, and men from the provinces of Cilicia and Asia.

cards.card_text: They board an Alexandrian ship that spent the winter at the island, with the Twin Brothers as its figurehead.
cards.verse_text: After three months we set sail in an Alexandrian ship that had wintered in the island.
cards.snippet: After three months we set sail in an Alexandrian ship that had wintered in the island.
